rules.prevention: Implement circuit breaker (failure_threshold=5, recovery_timeout=60s) on API client layer
rules.implementation: Add tenacity or pybreaker around API calls; bounded_retry remains as backstop
rules.expected_impact: Reduce transient_api incidents by ~40% through fast-fail and connection reset

rules.prevention: Enable google.api_core.retry.Retry as BigQuery client middleware
rules.implementation: from google.api_core import retry; client.query(sql, retry=retry.Retry())
rules.expected_impact: Offload retry to SDK layer; reduce platform retry budget consumption

rules.prevention: Upstream partition freshness monitor: alert if partition not refreshed by T-2h before pipeline window
rules.implementation: Add check_partition_freshness() to Airflow DAG pre-ingest; SLA_HOURS configurable
rules.expected_impact: Convert reactive recovery into proactive alert

rules.prevention: Pre-ingest schema drift detection: compare source columns to last-known-good manifest
rules.expected_impact: Catch schema drift at source boundary, not inside pipeline

rules.prevention: Escalate elevated_quarantine from WARNING to CRITICAL if trend persists
rules.implementation: Add quarantine_rate_trend() to metrics.py; if 3-run moving average > threshold, reclassify
rules.expected_impact: Leading-indicator escalation before quality degrades to CRITICAL

philosophy: Prevention rules are derived from measured patterns, not hypothetical risks. Every rule has a fault_kind that appeared in the ledger with a count justifying the investment.
